claim_ceiling: Abstract engineered feedback controller with finite energy storage and repair; demonstrates regulated recovery under declared interventions, not biological homeostasis, life, learning, agency or intelligence

source.model_class: Fixed-rule feedback control with finite reservoir and lossy actuator
source.scientific_context: Thermostat/control engineering provides an abiotic counterexample to interpreting setpoint recovery or homeostasis-like behavior as evidence of biological life. This benchmark is an abstract scalar compartment, not an empirically calibrated organism or thermostat model.

equations.repair_energy_consumed: if controller_enabled && sensor_available then min(repair_energy_demand, max_repair_power * dt, energy_after_idle) else 0
equations.energy_balance: energy_before + harvested_energy = energy_spilled + idle_energy_consumed + repair_energy_consumed + energy_after

cases.interpretation: A fixed controller recovers the declared integrity state by spending finite stored energy.
Identical damage without the feedback controller does not recover.
Stored energy alone does not restore integrity when feedback observation is unavailable.
A working controller cannot perform repair without available energy.
External energy supply can refill the store and enable repair; the source of energy is explicit.
Harvest, overflow spill, idle use, repair work and final storage reconcile to the energy balance.

metrics.recovery_latency: number of steps to return to target under a registered repeated intervention sequence
metrics.reserve_depletion_time: first tick when stored_energy reaches zero under repeated load
metrics.energy_balance_residual: energy_before + harvested - spill - idle - repair - energy_after

benchmark_tasks: Causal intervention: compare identical damage with controller on/off
Sensor ablation: compare identical damage with sensing available/unavailable
Energy ablation: compare identical damage with energy reserve present/depleted
Harvest dependence: quantify whether external energy input restores maintenance capacity
Energy closure: verify every step's energy balance and repair efficiency
False-positive ontology control: homeostasis-like setpoint recovery must not establish biological life, reproduction, learning, agency or intelligence
anti_leakage: A full trajectory is one system-level run; steps within it are not independent specimens.
Split parameter regimes and energy/damage schedules, not adjacent time steps from one run.
Keep intervention labels sealed from any learned detector evaluation.
Do not generalize this one-dimensional controller to biological metabolism without independent physical calibration.
